content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Extra's PostExtra Verified accountApril 9 at 11:34 PM · Shared with Public"Love on the Spectrum" couple Abbey Romeo and David Isaacman have reportedly split after nearly 5 years together. A source tells the US Sun that they couldn't get on the same page about marriage. According to the insider, "They couldn’t come to an agreement on when to get married. She was ready years ago, he still needed time."Abbey and David met in 2021 on Season 1 of the Netflix series, which follows adults with autism as they dive into the dating world.All reactions:4K893 comments448 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Livia Sol MoonI could tell in their looks when she found out that Madison was engaged that that’s what she really wanted and he wasn’t ready. Good for her for making the choice best for her happiness. These are very hard choices especially for us on the spectrum, but I know she’ll find the one for her. She’s so dang sweet and full of love 1w114View all 2 repliesAngel DianaI love that they made a very adult decision together based on their own lives at the time. I’m sad that this is the decision they came to. Maybe one or the other will change their mind and they can work it out.1w30Donnie ChambersShe did say she wanted him to be her boyfriend forever. He apparently took that very seriously1w115View 1 replyTao MoranAbbey is living her best life now. David opened many doors for her and they were a great couple but if he can’t commit then it’s good for her to move on.1w81View 1 replyTopaz IvoryIn the show that just aired, it seemed that Abby wasnt ready yet... and she didnt want kids. Im guessing something changed when they went to the engagement party1w56View all 14 repliesElisa TolleWe forget that for people on the spectrum, especially those with significant need for assistance in daily life, that relationships are even harder than they are for every day folks. We are lucky to love another person in general, adding extra stuff in the mix will always make things more challenging. I hope they both find what they need.
